articleSchema.id: string: stable hash of canonical official URL
articleSchema.title: string
articleSchema.launchDate: YYYY-MM-DD | null; only set when expressly identified as the product launch date

classificationPolicy.launch: Official notice of a Kampo or crude-drug product launch, sale start, or expressly identified new product.
classificationPolicy.recall: Official recall, voluntary recall, or recall notice for a Kampo or crude-drug product.
classificationPolicy.discontinued: Official sales end, manufacturing end, supply stop, or limited shipment notice for a Kampo or crude-drug product.
classificationPolicy.store: Official Kampo or crude-drug store opening or relocation notice. Do not classify as launch.
classificationPolicy.general: Other Kampo or crude-drug research, educational, regulatory, or company news.
exclusions: generic corporate news unrelated to Kampo or crude drugs

collectionPolicy.rotation: Split official sources deterministically into three groups and check one group per execution.
collectionPolicy.deduplication: Use a canonical official URL hash as the primary key, retain one source-rich official notice for each duplicate event.
collectionPolicy.displayDateRule: Show a launch date only when it is clearly extracted from the official announcement. Otherwise show the official notice date.

uiRequirements: Responsive Japanese interface with category badges for launch, recall, discontinued, store, and general.
Display manufacturer, product names, official notice date, known launch date, and official detail link.
Use browser-local read state; it must remain separate per device and browser.
Show member-company coverage and the latest collection status.
